title: Allocation-lock timeout hint must report the break file alloc.lock.break and stop calling alloc.lock safe to remove unconditionally
description: Follow-up from the QCLI-495 narrow review (team-lead, opum-doc earlier ruling: a named error showing the exact file, never auto-clearing). The timeout hint in src/cli/main.ts (the IdAllocationLockTimeoutError branch, about :4809-4819) never mentions <common-dir>/quest/alloc.lock.break. A break file left by a breaker killed between creating and writing it is never auto-cleared (unreadable pid), blocks breaking a stale alloc.lock, and today the hint says removing alloc.lock is safe, which is wrong while a live break holder exists. Not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The allocation-lock timeout hint reports whether alloc.lock.break is present and its holder (the pid, or the word unreadable).
The hint says removing alloc.lock is safe only when there is no live break holder, and names the exact break file path when one exists.

The hint never removes or clears the break file by itself; a test fixture with a live-pid break file and one with an unreadable break file each assert the hint text, and the test goes red when the break-file clause is removed.
